It can then discharge quickly into the train's batteries through charging rails and then start recharging itself while the train is running in service.

glosses: To cause (a substance) to fall in fine drops (for a liquid substance) or small pieces (for a solid substance).

examples.text: The confectioner sprinkled icing sugar over the cakes.
And the priest shall[…]sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord.

Over the centuries the movement of clans and tribes of people has provided the kind of crop that would emerge if a blind god had sprinkled seeds at random on a field[.]

glosses: To cover (an object) by sprinkling a substance on to it.

examples.text: The confectioner sprinkled the cakes with icing sugar.
